source: Standalone follow-up to Pilot001; foundation remains unchanged
task: Four explicitly addressed records. Eight possible values, UNKNOWN without a qualifying record. A visible score >=0.5 qualifies; address4 resets all slots.
internal_depth: Fixed; this follow-up tests memory reliability, not useful recurrent reasoning depth
controls: Same Transformer with actual latest source records from exact ledger
calibration: 2048 extra labelled admission events with observed scores spanning[0,1], disjoint seeded data. Choose midpoint of maximum negative and minimum positive learned gate if separable; otherwise best balanced error among adjacent gate midpoints. No weights change. Count extra labels and report fit failures. Per-checkpoint threshold chosen before main episode scoring.
known_information_limits: Low-margin visible scores are not semantic ambiguity. Separate paired identical observations with incompatible hidden intents will demonstrate the information limit by construction; never provide hidden intent to a control.
fairness: Same batches, labels and optimizer steps within seed/curriculum. Different event count across curricula, representations, parameter counts, and compute; NOT equal-compute ranking. Four-address dispatch/reset are engineered scaffolding shared across arms. Calibration has extra labels; exact control has supplied policy knowledge.
scope: SYNTHETIC_MEMORY_MECHANISM; not general language, new identity, learning traces, low-bit execution, NSS integration or architecture acceptance
safety: Synthetic local data only; no external downloads, uploads, deployment, live NSS DB or repository writes

acceptance.baseline_screen: At horizons0 and16, each seed has >=95% known accuracy on retain/overwrite and >=95% unknown accuracy on mixed_unknown/reset. Report failures, never exclude seeds.
acceptance.clean_long_horizon: All five seeds meet baseline; at4096, each >=95% known and unknown on corresponding clean conditions and retain drop vs16 <=1 percentage point.
acceptance.low_margin: Separate challenge: all five seeds >=95% on each near_reject/near_write condition at4096. Not concealed in clean pass.
acceptance.decision: Keep as research candidate/revise named mechanism/reject scoped method/gather missing evidence. No production qualification.
